items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Eddie Haywood called me up and asked me to come to a recording session. When I did, I went out that evening and we made a recording and I played on his record, 'The Sunny Side of the Street,' with Eddie Haywood and so he immediately wanted to hire me.

ctx.x: After that, I recorded with Lionel Hampton and did a whole series of recordings with them during the time that I was with the band, from 1940 until -- through '42. After that, I went to service. When I came out at the end of service, I went into some recordings with Eddie Haywood (PHONETIC) group. Then I used to record with what they used to call the rhythm and blues groups in those times. That was before the rock and roll stuff. They called them rhythm and blues.
